chemistry-killer-11.title: Saffisa Rakkoo, Seera Le Chatelier fi Seelii Galvaanii
chemistry-killer-11.topic: Saffisa Rakkoo, Seera Le Chatelier fi Seelii Galvaanii
chemistry-killer-11.goal: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.
chemistry-killer-11.material:
Raawwii $\mathrm{N_2O_4(g) \rightleftharpoons 2NO_2(g)}$ kaayyoon wal-madaalii koncentireeshinii ho'a murtaa'e irratti $K = 0.4$ (kuufama dhiisi) dha. Ho'a kana irratti weenii sadan keessatti $\mathrm{N_2O_4}$ fi $\mathrm{NO_2}$ tokko tokkoon galchinee yeroo gaarii dheeraa dhiise.
(ka) Bal'ina 2.0 L, $\mathrm{N_2O_4}$ 0.4 mol, $\mathrm{NO_2}$ 0.4 mol
(kb) Bal'ina 0.5 L, $\mathrm{N_2O_4}$ 0.1 mol, $\mathrm{NO_2}$ 0.2 mol
(kc) Bal'ina 2.0 L, $\mathrm{N_2O_4}$ 0.2 mol, $\mathrm{NO_2}$ 0.4 mol
Indeeksii raawwii $Q$ fi $K$ wal-bira qabuun weenii tokko tokkoo keessatti hanga wal-madaalii ga'utti kallattii raawwii kan sirrii ta'een wal-qabsiisi kam?

Indeeksii raawwii $Q$ fi $K$ wal-bira qabuun weenii tokko tokkoo keessatti hanga wal-madaalii ga'utti kallattii raawwii kan sirrii ta'een wal-qabsiisi kam?
chemistry-killer-11.s.s1.explain:
Tarkaanfii 1: Koncentireeshinii lakkaa'i. (ka) 2.0 L: [N2O4] = 0.4/2.0 = 0.2 M, [NO2] = 0.2 M. (kb) 0.5 L: [N2O4] = 0.1/0.5 = 0.2 M, [NO2] = 0.2/0.5 = 0.4 M. (kc) 2.0 L: [N2O4] = 0.1 M, [NO2] = 0.2 M.
